description:
UniqueHeat®  was started 15 years ago in a small town in Southern Michigan. 

It was our dream to be the very best Infrared Space Heater Brand in America.  

With one of the best warranties on earth (10 Years), and over a quarter-million customers we feel we’re living our dream, for one simple reason..

We literally put caring for people first.. 

The most important part of every UniqueHeat® isn’t some high-tech feature or component.  ..it’s the person using it. 

When you warm yourself with a UniqueHeat®, it’s not just about how great the heater is.. 

It’s about how great You Yourself are.. 

UniqueHeat® brings out the best in you… 

We believe making a quality product is just the beginning..

To be truly great, a company has to stand for something. 

UniqueHeat® stands for Care and stands alongside our customers and affiliates!

It’s our commitment to make sure as an affiliate you’re delighted with representing UniqueHeat® and your overall commission and payout experience.

That’s why UniqueHeat® has positioned our payout structure so profitable.  Just one sale puts just under $25 in your pocket!

Our Heaters are Unique in that they are cool to the touch and Safe around Pets and Children. Please visit www.uniqueheat.com and watch the infomercial to see how unique this heater is and this affiliate opportunity.

Each Heater comes with a Free 10-year replacement warranty, Free unlimited lost remote replacement, Free UV replacement and Free Shipping!

This product you will be promoting literally has zero competition offering the same features and value proposition in the space heater category.

Homeowners don’t just like their heaters..  They love them. UniqueHeat® has just under a 5-star rating on Amazon.

Our customers affectionately call it “Sunshine in a box“. 

We look forward to your success as an affiliate and welcome any questions.

We love to hear the wonderful and surprising success stories our affiliates experience promoting UniqueHeat®.
